jobs.title: AI Native Creative Strategist - EdTech (French fluent )
jobs.description:
**What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds?**

Then you’ll love this.

We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content).

Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement.

**This isn’t another content job.** Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale.

Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents.

**WHAT AI-NATIVE CONTENT MEANS AT PARADOX**
-------------------------------------------

Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make.

Our creative machine has to be able to:

**1. Read the signals.** Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now.

**2. Hold the full context of Paradox.** Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain.

**3. Generate in our voice.** Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English.

**4. Ship.** Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform.

**5. Measure with real KPIs.** Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes.

**6. Learn and loop on its own.** Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting.

This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day.

**OUR MISSION**
---------------

At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging:

* Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)
* Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals)
* Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

**Short history**

Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world.

**YOUR MISSION**
----------------

You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity.

Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe.

In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste.

**YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS**
------------------------

### **1. Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy**

* Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization.
* Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry.
* Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn.
* The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit.
* At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence.

### **2. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery**

* Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision.
* Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart.
* Deliver what you pitch.
* The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts.
* At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them.

### **3. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents**

* Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules.
* Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it.
* The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions.
* At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep

jobs.title: Creative AI Video Editor
jobs.description:
We are seeking a creative and technically skilled **Creative AI Video Editor** to join our Dubai-based team. The ideal candidate should have practical expertise in AI-powered content creation, image and video generation, and professional video editing, with the ability to turn creative concepts into high-quality visual content.

**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Arrangement:** Office-based, Dubai

**Working Schedule**

* 9 working hours per day.
* 1 weekly day off.
* Flexibility to work additional hours when required to meet production demands, project milestones, or tight deadlines.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on proficiency in various AI-powered creative platforms and content generation tools.
* Proven ability to create visual assets using AI image and video generation technologies.
* Strong prompt development skills, with the ability to refine instructions to achieve specific creative results.
* Solid video editing capabilities using industry-standard editing applications.
* Experience integrating AI-generated visuals, footage, and elements into professionally edited video content.
* Good understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and creative execution.
* Ability to explore emerging AI technologies, test new platforms, and incorporate effective tools into existing creative workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver engaging content while meeting project timelines.

Pay: AED18,000.00 - AED30,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Portfolio Link:
* Can you join ASAP?

Language:

* Arabic (Required)
* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.company: AD&M International Advertising, PR and Events
jobs.title: Senior Creative Designer – Graphic Design, Motion Graphics & AI
jobs.description:
Senior Creative Designer – Graphic Design, Motion Graphics & AI

**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Salary:** AED 6,000–8,000 per month (depending on experience and capabilities)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Ad&M International Advertising LLC

Ad&M International is a Dubai-based 360-degree media communication and advertising agency with over 15 years of experience in the GCC market. We specialise in media buying, advertising, public relations, digital marketing, creative production, outdoor advertising and corporate events.

We are looking for a highly creative and talented **Senior Creative Designer** to join our growing team in Dubai.

Job Overview

The ideal candidate should have a strong creative mindset, excellent design skills and the ability to independently conceptualise and execute high-quality creative work across different platforms.

We are looking for someone who can go beyond routine designing, bring fresh ideas to the table and create visually engaging campaigns that make brands stand out.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop original and visually appealing creative concepts for various client brands and campaigns.
* Design high-quality social media posts, digital advertisements, promotional materials, brochures, flyers, presentations and print advertisements.
* Create motion graphics, animated posts, promotional videos and engaging video content.
* Develop AI-powered creative visuals, advertising concepts and innovative campaign materials.
* Work on branding, campaign identities, product promotions and corporate communication materials.
* Understand client briefs and translate them into impactful visual communication.
* Stay updated with the latest creative trends, design technologies and AI tools.
* Handle multiple client projects while maintaining high standards of quality and timely delivery.
* Collaborate with the digital marketing, account management and events teams.

Required Skills & Expertise

**Essential software skills:**

* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Premiere Pro

**AI and creative technology:**

* Experience with AI creative tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to generate and enhance creative visuals using AI.
* Understanding of AI-powered video and motion content creation.

Candidate Profile

* 4–7 years of relevant professional experience preferred.
* Strong creative thinking and conceptualisation abilities.
* Excellent visual sense, typography, colour combinations and layout skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with advertising agencies or digital marketing companies will be an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.
* A strong and updated creative portfolio is mandatory.

What We Expect

We are not looking for someone who simply executes design instructions. We need a creative professional who can understand a brief, think differently, suggest new ideas and consistently deliver impressive creative output.

If you are passionate about creativity, advertising, design innovation, motion graphics and AI-powered content creation, we would love to hear from you.

**Application:** Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with their creative portfolio, including graphic designs, motion graphics and AI-generated work.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: AED6,000.00 - AED8,000.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* UAE: 2 years (Preferred)
* Motion Graphics: 2 years (Preferred)
* Video editing: 2 years (Preferred)
* Adobe Photoshop: 3 years (Required)
* Adobe Illustrator: 3 years (Required)
* Adobe After Effects: 3 years (Preferred)
* Adobe Premiere Pro: 3 years (Preferred)
* AI creative tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway : 1 year (Preferred)
* Creating AI Generated Visuals: 2 years (Preferred)
* Advertising Agency: 4 years (Required)
* Creative Agency: 4 years (Required)

Language:

* Malayalam (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Creative Director & Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company

**Billionaire Collections** is a Dubai-based luxury retail company specialising in exclusive luxury smartphones, premium watches, and high-end lifestyle accessories. With an established presence in the luxury market and international brand partnerships, we bring together some of the world's most distinguished names in luxury and innovation. Our focus is on exceptional products, refined customer experiences, and delivering excellence to a discerning international clientele.

**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** Marketing & Brand Development

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, creative, and commercially focused **Creative Director & Digital Marketing Manager** to lead our brand's digital presence, creative production, and marketing growth.

The ideal candidate will combine strong creative vision with practical digital marketing expertise. You should understand how to develop compelling video concepts, build premium brand experiences, manage social media platforms, and execute performance-driven advertising campaigns that generate genuine customer interest and business opportunities.

This is a leadership position for someone who understands both the creative and commercial sides of marketing. You will oversee our in-house content creation team, work closely with photographers, videographers, editors, and designers, and take responsibility for developing campaigns that strengthen brand identity, expand audience reach, generate qualified leads, and increase sales.

Experience in luxury retail, premium lifestyle products, high-end accessories, or luxury technology brands will be a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities1. Creative Direction & Campaign Development

* Develop original creative concepts for digital campaigns, brand storytelling, product launches, and social media content.
* Introduce fresh video formats, engaging content series, and distinctive campaign ideas that differentiate the brand from competitors.
* Lead the creative process from initial concept and scripting through production, editing, approval, and publication.
* Create compelling video hooks, scripts, captions, headlines, and on-screen messaging.
* Establish a consistent visual identity and premium creative standard across all marketing channels.
* Identify relevant social media trends and transform them into brand-appropriate creative opportunities.
* Ensure every campaign communicates the brand's positioning, product value, and exclusivity.

2. Digital Advertising & Performance Marketing

* Plan, execute, and manage advertising campaigns through Meta Ads Manager (Facebook and Instagram) and Google Ads.
* Develop strategies focused on brand awareness, customer acquisition, website visits, qualified inquiries, and sales conversions.
* Research and segment audiences based on customer interests, purchasing behaviour, and market opportunities.
* Manage advertising expenditure and optimize campaigns to improve cost per lead, conversion rates, and return on ad spend (ROAS).
* Conduct A/B testing across creatives, advertisements, audiences, and campaign formats.
* Develop retargeting campaigns to convert previous website visitors, social media users, and interested prospects into customers.
* Monitor campaign performance and prepare actionable reports for management.

3. Brand Development & Marketing Strategy

* Build and execute marketing plans that support long-term brand growth and commercial objectives.
* Develop strategies that strengthen brand awareness, reputation, customer confidence, and market positioning.
* Plan promotional activities, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand awareness initiatives.
* Identify new opportunities to reach high-value customers and expand market presence.
* Maintain a consistent luxury identity across websites, social media, advertisements, and other digital touchpoints.
* Work with management to align marketing activities with sales objectives and business priorities.

4. Social Media & Digital Content Management

* Oversee the brand's presence across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Develop and manage monthly and weekly content calendars.
* Direct the creation of Reels, short-form videos, product photography, promotional graphics, Stories, and campaign materials.
* Ensure regular publishing and maintain high standards of content quality.
* Monitor audience engagement, comments, direct messages, and customer feedback.
* Identify potential buyers through social media interactions and coordinate with the sales department for timely follow-up.
* Build meaningful audience relationships and encourage genuine product interest rather than focusing only on views and follower numbers.

5. Creative Production & Team Leadership

* Lead and supervise the in-house content creation team, including photographers, videographers, editors, and designers.
* Assign responsibilities, establish production schedules, and ensure timely completion of creative projects.
* Prepare clear creative briefs with concepts, references, deliverables, and production requirements.
* Direct photoshoots, video productions, editing styles, and visual presentations.
* Review and approve content before publication to ensure consistency and quality.
* Manage relationships with freelance creatives and external production partners.
* Encourage creative innovation, efficiency, and continuous improvement within the team.

6. Website, UX & Digital Experience

* Oversee the visual presentation and creative direction of company websites and digital platforms.
* Work with web developers and designers to improve website layouts, landing pages, product presentations, and user journeys.
* Understand the fundamentals of user experience (UX), user interface (UI), and conversion-focused design.
* Recommend improvements to website functionality, navigation, content structure, and customer experience.
